name: Galilean
description: Galileo's notebook: Jupiter drawn as a small open circle with its four moons strung out beside it on a line, a little differently every night.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 37%; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color1); mask: radial-gradient(closest-side, transparent 60%, #000 60%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)); mask: radial-gradient(ellipse @p(4.2, 5, 6)% @lp()% at @calc(50 + @p(-1, 1) * @r(19, 45))% 50%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse @p(4.2, 5, 6)% @lp()% at @calc(50 + @p(-1, 1) * @r(19, 45))% 50%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse @p(4.2, 5, 6)% @lp()% at @calc(50 + @p(-1, 1) * @r(19, 45))% 50%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse @p(4.2, 5, 6)% @lp()% at @calc(50 + @p(-1, 1) * @r(19, 45))% 50%, #000 100%, transparent 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
